blurb: Guests can enjoy a 70's cabin style tasting room, a cozy Barrel Lounge, and a covered patio with 20 taps of draught beer, cider, wine, spirits, and non-alcoholic options. The kitchen serves rotating pizzas, seasonal salads, and snacks made from scratch with local ingredients. The Barrel Lounge can be reserved for private events of 8 to 38 people on weekdays.
extraNote: No reservations for taproom seating; first-come, first-served · Barrel Lounge bookings require pre-authorized credit card, contract, minimum 1 week advance, auto-gratuity 20%, and contracted minimum spend · Taproom group bookings require minimum 1 week advance, auto-gratuity 20%, 15 minute grace period for arrival · Open all holidays except Christmas Day · Patio open May to October
